mapper.sql: id, title, content, author_id, author_name, create_time, update_time, is_deleted, status, summary, cover_image, category_id, tags, view_count, like_count, comment_count, sort, process_instance_id, task_id, audit_status, audit_remark
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.author_id, a.author_name, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.is_deleted, a.status, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.sort FROM article a LEFT JOIN blog_attachments ba ON a.id = ba.article_id AND ba.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 and a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) as article_count, SUM(view_count) as total_views, SUM(like_count) as total_likes FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY article_count DESC
SELECT tags, COUNT(*) as article_count, SUM(view_count) as total_views FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != '' GROUP BY tags ORDER BY article_count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT a.id, a.title as article_title, a.author_name, a.process_instance_id, a.task_id, a.audit_status, a.create_time FROM article a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.task_id IS NOT NULL AND a.audit_status IN (1, 3) ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

FROM article WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, task_id = #{taskId}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{articleId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE article SET status = 1, audit_status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{articleId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 4
